channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Zombie House Flipping: Family Business
channel.desc: Tommy Harr thinks he's found an easy flip in Columbus's desirable Clintonville neighborhood. The bank claims the dated foreclosure only needs cosmetic updates, but when Tommy's dad, Chris, and brother Jake inspect the creepy "time capsule," hidden problems emerge - mold, failing mechanicals, and foundation cracks. The place is a steal, and Tommy's mom, Katie, proposes a risky and expensive redesign that will boost the ARV: deleting a main-floor bedroom to create two luxury primary ensuites.
